job.job_description:
About the Role:




We are looking for an innovative and detail-oriented Prompt Engineer to design, develop, and optimize prompts that maximize the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI systems.




Key Responsibilities:




Prompt Design & Optimization

Develop, test, and refine prompt strategies for LLMs (e.g., GPT-4/5, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) to achieve desired behaviors and outputs.

Engineer few-shot, chain-of-thought, and system prompts for use in chatbots, content generation, summarization, and reasoning applications.

Design evaluation frameworks and A/B testing pipelines to measure prompt effectiveness, accuracy, tone, and response quality.

Build prompt libraries and reusable components for cross-functional teams.


Collaboration & Integration

Work closely with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate optimized prompts into AI products and pipelines.

Partner with UX writers and product designers to align prompt design with user experience goals.

Collaborate with software engineers to automate and deploy prompt workflows using APIs or orchestration tools.

Participate in model fine-tuning discussions, helping guide dataset creation and instruction tuning.



Preferred Qualifications:



Experience with fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS).

Knowledge of MLOps, data curation, or AI evaluation frameworks (e.g., PromptLayer, Weights & Biases, HumanLoop).

Background in creative writing, UX writing, or conversational design.

Familiarity with multimodal prompt engineering (text-to-image, text-to-audio, etc.).
